notes_for_editor: Thin record: each page has a one-line history. The Forest Lookouts page credits both dates to 'Kresek', so the pages may share one origin; we could not check it. Elevation differs: 4548 ft on idahofirelookouts.com; TopoQuest lists the summit at 4540 ft, not used in the story. The abandoned event is left out because sources give only the decade. The record's coordinates differ slightly from TopoQuest's, not checked. No photos or post-removal description found.
